subject: stout armoured knight in blue plate with a red plume, longsword in the right hand, kite shield on the left arm
motion: a victory pose: raising the sword high overhead and planting the shield
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: golden sparkles around the raised blade

plan.source: Three-quarter right; right hand holds sword low across front pointing down-right; left arm raises kite shield before chest; left foot forward, right back; slight forward lean, head facing right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans slightly back-right, weight to right foot; right arm draws sword lower/back by thigh, tip down-right; left arm lifts shield a bit higher forward, elbow bent; knees flex; head tucks, facing right.

Key: torso drives up slightly left, weight to left foot; right arm fully extends, sword high overhead on right, near vertical; left arm straight, shield planted tip to ground ahead-left, rim outward; knees firm; head tilts up to blade.
frames.effect: golden sparkles clustering around raised blade tip; pale arc trail along sword’s upswing from low-front to overhead on right side

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso eases, slight lean left; right arm keeps sword high but elbow soft, blade angled forward; left arm braced on planted shield; weight centered; head forward-right.
frames.effect: golden sparkles around raised blade; a few small dots just below it

frames.pose: Recovery: torso returns toward neutral; right arm brings sword down to front diagonal toward guard; left arm lifts shield off ground toward chest, elbow bent; weight splits; head level, facing right.
